cue_ablation: Label-independent deletion of CUE_TOKENS with word boundaries before the TF-IDF fit. Common words (car, gun, windows) are in the list, so this is an aggressive scrub, not a pure causal effect.

isotonic_probe.note: fit_on_test is a contamination control: the calibrator sees the same labels that are then scored. It is not a valid ECE.

model.note: random_state is fixed. The seed axis is the split only.

not_this_file: Not GPT-2 and not the committed MiniLM/BGE matrices.
Not a Wilcoxon or Bonferroni result.
The 14 x 10 x 4 design is not run here.
